title: Cognee
description: Persistent semantic memory backed by a Cognee server, exposed as three agent tools.

Remember plain text, recall memory results while requesting references, and check background processing. The knowledge graph captures semantic relationships; it is not an AST, import graph, or call graph.

cognee.base_url.title: Server URL
cognee.base_url.description: Base URL of the Cognee server. Self-hosted Cognee defaults to http://localhost:8000. For Cognee Cloud, use the instance URL from platform.cognee.ai.

cognee.api_key.title: API Key
cognee.api_key.description: Cognee API key sent as the X-Api-Key header. Falls back to COGNEE_API_KEY. Self-hosted servers with access control disabled can leave this blank.

cognee.dataset.title: Dataset
cognee.dataset.description: Default Cognee dataset used by all agent tools. Tool calls stay in this operator-controlled scope unless per-call overrides are enabled.

cognee.allow_dataset_override.title: Allow dataset override
cognee.allow_dataset_override.description: Allow agents to select a dataset per call. Leave off when several agents should share one operator-controlled memory scope.

cognee.search_type.title: Default recall strategy
cognee.search_type.description: How recall retrieves memory. Graph completion decomposition is the semantic default; the agent can override it per call.

cognee.top_k.title: Recall results (top_k)
cognee.top_k.description: Maximum number of results recall retrieves per query.

cognee.request_timeout.title: Request timeout (s)
cognee.request_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for one Cognee request.
